# PRIMORDIUM — Book II
## A Challenge for the Decoder

> *“The road bends inward. The gate is a ring. The count is everything.”*

This is the second book. It is harder. Everything you need is on this page —
but nothing is given in order. The key to every page is **hidden inside the
previous page**. You must walk the path from the beginning, or not at all.

The runes are the same as Book I (A–Z, each bound to its prime), transliterated
below. The sign of the series remains **257**.

## THE SEAL

The final page is guarded by a cryptographic seal (Ed25519). The public key and
signature are:

```
PUBLIC KEY : kgKXI2bCXJiH54MKT9qxRnsjNUaKNyMikV6XPY54QIE=
SIGNATURE  : y7iVqFWvNOTOsd8UwioHMbIIAo7K7ORDsXfmLBVcJFwjAdZrVwLIaYIy3TvNizk4mT7QI8GsQITyh8TGNAVlAg==
```

The seal verifies **one word** — the answer to the riddle in the final page.
If you can speak the word, the seal proves you were here.

---

## WHAT TO DELIVER

1. The full plaintext of **PAGE IV** (and the name of its **two** transforms).
2. The **key to PAGE V** (a single word — where did you find it?) and the
   description of the ring on which it sings (how many letters? how ordered?).
3. The full plaintext of **PAGE V** and **PAGE VI**, naming every transform used.
4. The **final word**, verified against the seal.

*“The circle has no end, yet it ends where it began.”*
